items.title: Frank Adams Interview, 1959-01-20
items.q: Eddie's up there, but Walter died. He said, I was the younger brother, died. Only Eddie's living.

ctx.x: Yeah, but I mean the other stuff.

Oh yeah, then the other white people began then to all around the house, they said we were going to kill up a lot of colored folks on the ground. That riot, you see, was the police on them. And doing that to Mr. Stacks, the same boy, I tell you I know this one, probably his dad. He lived next door to us. Come and warn my dad and told him that some hoodlums going to form up a gang and come all around and kill all the colored folks. On account of that riot. We didn't know nothing about them. We were way out in…
He's a good friend of yours. Oh yeah.
